name: My Gg Plugins
headline: my-gg-plugins: Claude Code skill for automation
short_description: My Claude Code plugin marketplace - skills, agents, hooks, commands
author: GGPrompts

sections.overview:
My GG Plugins is an automation skill that provides access to a Claude Code plugin marketplace. It enables users to discover and integrate skills, agents, hooks, and commands into their workflows. Owned and maintained by GGPrompts, this skill centralizes plugin management for Claude-based automation tasks.
Browse and discover available Claude plugins and extensions
Install skills and agents to extend Claude functionality
Access pre-built commands and hooks for automation workflows
Manage and organize installed plugins across projects
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/GGPrompts/my-gg-plugins`
sections.usage:
```
Find me a plugin that can help [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector automate [TASK]. Provide details on its features, pricing, and compatibility with my existing tools.
```
Copy

```
# Plugin Recommendation: Salesforce Automation Assistant

**Features:**
- Automates lead entry and follow-up emails
- Integrates with Salesforce CRM
- Supports custom workflows
- Offers real-time analytics

**Pricing:**
- Free tier available
- Pro version: $29.99/month
- Enterprise version: Custom pricing

**Compatibility:**
- Works with Salesforce Lightning
- Compatible with major email providers
- API access for custom integrations

**Why This Plugin?:**
The Salesforce Automation Assistant is ideal for [COMPANY] as it streamlines lead management, a critical task in the [INDUSTRY] sector. Its customizable workflows ensure it can adapt to your specific processes, and the real-time analytics provide valuable insights into your sales pipeline.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
